summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Social Protection for Vulnerable Populations. Equip yourself with essential tools to make a difference in communities.
lede: Social protection for vulnerable populations combines policies and programs that address poverty, inequality and life-cycle risks. This course is for professionals responsible for designing, managing or evaluating social welfare and poverty-reduction initiatives. It develops practical skills in vulnerability assessment and targeting, cash-transfer operations, digital registry workflows, and monitoring and evaluation of social assistance.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the design, oversight, and evaluation of social welfare and poverty reduction initiatives.
audience: Vulnerability Assessment Specialists focused on poverty
modules: Social Protection Foundations and Global Standards
Cash Transfer Programming and Social Insurance
Digital Social Registries and MIS Architecture
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in social policy, international development, or public administration. A basic understanding of statistical concepts and poverty indicators is recommended. No prior programming or advanced econometrics knowledge is required, though familiarity with Excel for data analysis is beneficial.
